summary.intent: Diagnose and fix a failing CI run on PR 271, specifically the Test / Rust job.
summary.outcome: Found that two InheritedLayer struct literals in the workspace were causing the `just test-rust` step to exit 101. Fixed both, confirmed the full workspace suite passes as CI runs it (983 tests), then formatted, linted, staged and created a signed commit. The transcript does not show a push or a re-run of CI.

repo: CI's Rust test step is `just test-rust`; it exited 101, which is the Rust test/panic failure code.
The failure came from InheritedLayer struct literals that needed updating, and there were two such literals across the workspace.
Reproducing CI locally requires running the full workspace suite, not just a single crate; that run covers 983 tests.
Commits in this repo are signed.
workflow: Saving the failed-step log to a file and searching it was more effective than reading the job log inline, since the whole-job log search did not isolate the failure.
Grepping the workspace for every literal of a changed type finds all call sites before fixing, rather than fixing only the one CI reported.
Run the same command CI runs (the full workspace suite) before committing to confirm the fix.
Format and lint before committing so the fix does not trigger a new CI failure.

friction: Several attempts (reading the job failure, searching the whole job log, showing the job summary) were needed before the actual failing step log was located and saved to a file.
open_items: Push the commit and confirm that CI on PR 271 passes; the transcript ends at commit creation.
